The merchant states, unverified, that it will switch only at 1.75% + $0.12. That price yields $68,400 revenue and a 17.11% gross margin, below the 22% enterprise minimum, so it is prohibited without an approved strategic exception, and none was requested. We counter at 1.87% + $0.12: revenue $72,720, gross profit $16,020, gross margin 22.03%, meeting the minimum.
